Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From cup +‎ -eta. Some usages influenced by French cuvette.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central) [kuˈβɛ.tə]
  • IPA(key): (Balearic) [kuˈbə.tə]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [kuˈbe.ta]

Noun

[edit]

cubeta f (plural cubetes)

  1. (chemistry) cuvette
  2. (photography) tray
  3. (printing) plate mark

Further reading

[edit]
  • “cubeta”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007

Chavacano

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Inherited from Spanish cubeta (“bucket”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /kuˈbeta/, [kuˈbe.t̪a]
  • Hyphenation: cu‧be‧ta

Noun

[edit]

cubeta

  1. toilet
    Synonyms: casillas, escusao

Galician

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

    Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese cubeta, from cuba + -eta.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /kuˈbeta/ [kuˈβ̞e.t̪ɐ]
    • Rhymes: -eta
    • Hyphenation: cu‧be‧ta

    Noun

    [edit]

    cubeta f (plural cubetas)

    1. (nautical) kind of bucket for bailing out water
    2. tub, bucket, pail
    3. cuvette

    Related terms

    [edit]
    • cuba

    References

    [edit]
    • Antón Luís Santamarina Fernández, editor (2006–2013), “cubeta”, in Dicionario de Dicionarios da lingua galega [Dictionary of Dictionaries of the Galician language] (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega
    • Antón Luís Santamarina Fernández, Ernesto Xosé González Seoane, María Álvarez de la Granja, editors (2003–2018), “cubeta”, in Tesouro informatizado da lingua galega (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega
    • Rosario Álvarez Blanco, editor (2014–2024), “cubeta”, in Tesouro do léxico patrimonial galego e portugués (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega, →ISSN

    Old Galician-Portuguese

    [edit]

    Etymology

    [edit]

      From cuba + -eta.

      Noun

      [edit]

      cubeta f (plural cubetas)

      1. (hapax legomenon) diminutive of cuba

      Descendants

      [edit]
      • Galician: cubeta
      • Portuguese: cubeta

      References

      [edit]
      • Barreiro, Xavier Varela; Guinovart, Xavier Gómez (2006–2018), “cubeta”, in Corpus Xelmírez: corpus lingüístico da Galicia medieval [Corpus Xelmírez: linguistic corpus of Medieval Galicia] (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega

      Portuguese

      [edit]
      Portuguese Wikipedia has an article on:
      cubeta
      Wikipedia pt

      Etymology

      [edit]

        Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese cubeta, from cuba + -eta. Sense 2 is a semantic loan from French cuvette.

        Pronunciation

        [edit]
         
        • (Brazil) IPA(key): /kuˈbe.tɐ/
        • (Brazil) IPA(key): /kuˈbe.tɐ/
          • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /kuˈbe.ta/
        • (Portugal) IPA(key): /kuˈbe.tɐ/ [kuˈβe.tɐ]

        • Rhymes: -etɐ
        • Hyphenation: cu‧be‧ta

        Noun

        [edit]

        cubeta f (plural cubetas)

        1. diminutive of cuba
        3. (analytical chemistry) cuvette

        Further reading

        [edit]
        • “cubeta”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
        • “cubeta”, in Dicionário infopédia da Lingua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Porto: Porto Editora, 2003–2026
        • “cubeta”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026
        • “cubeta”, in Michaelis Dicionário Brasileiro da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), São Paulo: Editora Melhoramentos, 2015–2026, →ISBN

        Spanish

        [edit]

        Etymology

        [edit]

        From cuba +‎ -eta.

        Pronunciation

        [edit]
        • IPA(key): /kuˈbeta/ [kuˈβ̞e.t̪a]
        • Rhymes: -eta
        • Syllabification: cu‧be‧ta

        Noun

        [edit]

        cubeta f (plural cubetas)

        1. cuvette
        2. (Honduras, Mexico) bucket, pail (container)
          Synonym: balde

        Descendants

        [edit]
        • → Tagalog: kubeta

        Adjective

        [edit]

        cubeta f

        1. feminine singular of cubeto

        Further reading

        [edit]
        • “cubeta”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025
